text:
elaine: FYI customer hit onboarding gate on firstcall. CLI just prints "Request failed (402)" and they think it's a creds problem. They signed up via SSO invite so never saw billing prompt.

alex: Ugh. Do we have the raw response body? That will tell us if it's billing_required vs auth.

elaine: Pasted from support: 
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood-inference.test/v1/generate 
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer sk_test_abc' 
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' 
  -d '{"model":"redwood-1","input":"hello"}'
```
HTTP/1.1 402 Payment Required
Body: {"error":{"message":"workspace_incomplete","code":"billing_required"}}

sam: That body is explicit. Our CLI/SDK plumbing currently hides that message behind a generic mapped error. We should surface error.error.message and any onboard URL the server provides. Filing a short fix.

maria: Short-term workaround: ask user to visit https://console.redwood-inference.test/onboarding or org settings > Billing and finish setup. For SSO-invite orgs the redirect that normally triggers onboarding may be suppressed. Added note to support playbook.

devex-bot: Known issue DEVEX-724: SSO-invite flows sometimes omit onboarding redirect. Workaround doc: https://go.redwood/onboard-ssogap :warning:

jordan: I'll propose a tiny API addition: include onboarding_required: true and onboarding_url: string in the error payload when org state != completed. That lets SDKs present a CTA. Also adding a new WorkspaceOnboardingRequired error subclass in SDKs.

alex: I'll try to repro with a test SSO invite org. If we can't reproduce, adding the explicit fields from Jordan will still let SDKs be deterministic.

sam: Also add a telemetry flag first_call_onboarding_failure to count how many users are blocked on first-call vs later. Could inform product prioritization.

elaine: Customer confirmed they finished billing and then the same curl returned 200 and model output. They were stuck for ~40min.

maria: I'll update quickstart docs to add an SSO footnote: "If you accept an SSO invite you may need to complete billing in the console to make your first API request." Small docs PR incoming.

jordan: Filed REDWOOD-1229 for API error payload and REDWOOD-1230 for SDK mapping. I'll include unit tests to ensure CLI prints server error.message and onboarding_url when present.

elaine: Thanks all. Leaving this thread bookmarked so support can reference it. If anyone wants to pair on the CLI/user-facing text tomorrow I can help.
